title: Collision time
description: Essential: The response must correctly compute the time for A to reach B, using kinematics or energy to find initial speed and motion under constant acceleration.

title: Landing distance separation
description: Essential: The response must correctly compute the horizontal distance between the landing points of A and B after the collision and fall.

title: Pre-collision velocity
description: Important: The response must apply work-energy or kinematics to determine the speed of A just before collision.

title: Post-collision velocities
description: Important: The response must correctly analyze the elastic collision (energy and momentum conserved) to find velocities of A and B immediately after collision.

title: Time of flight
description: Important: The response must correctly compute the free-fall time from the table height for both balls.

title: Horizontal displacements
description: Important: The response must correctly compute the horizontal displacement of each ball during fall, accounting for post-collision motion.

title: Sign or direction error
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the student incorrectly assigns signs to velocities, accelerations, or displacements, leading to wrong relative positions.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Award if the student explicitly checks or converts units consistently throughout the calculation.
